description: Fogg Dam Flux Data Collection is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Terrestrial Ecosystem Research Network's Data Discovery. This dataset consists of measurements of the exchange of energy and mass between the surface and the atmospheric boundary-layer in tropical woodland using eddy covariance techniques. The site was situated within a wetland that flooded seasonally. The principle vegetation was Oryza rufipogon, Pseudoraphis spinescens and Eleocharis dulcis. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Terrestrial Ecosystem Research Network's Data Discovery. Its tags are AU-Fog, Eddy Covariance, tropical woodland. It offers 7 resource(s) in HTML, PNG. The portal shows 2026-06-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
